canonical.title: Weekend at Agnes (Sint-Martens-Bodegem) — lodging, day-trips, tech conferences

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Agnes
siblings.summary: Three B&Bs in Sint-Martens-Bodegem are walkable to Agnes. Louis 1924 is the chef's own property and ships a shuttle; De Onsemhoeve is the closest and best-reviewed; B&B Bodegem is the cheapest but the weakest.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Agnes
siblings.summary: Eight character stays you can taxi home to after dinner at Agnes — from a walk-back wellness B&B next door to a cellist's neo-Palladian villa 17 km away.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Agnes
siblings.summary: Curated half- and full-day options around Sint-Martens-Bodegem — Brussels essentials, Pajottenland breweries and Bruegel walks, Leuven/Mechelen day-trips, family parks, and what's actually on the 30-31 May 2026 weekend.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Agnes
siblings.summary: Brussels-area IT conferences and dev meetups within ~30 km of Agnes (Sint-Martens-Bodegem) for 2026, anchored on FOSDEM, EU Open Source Week, Cybersec Europe, EuroBSDCon, and AI Summit Brussels.
